sources.entry: Zettlr - A Markdown Editor for the 21st century.

summary.one_liner: Zettlr is a free, open-source Markdown editor and publication workbench built on Electron, aimed at note-taking, Zettelkasten-style knowledge management, and exporting writing to publication formats.
summary.what_it_does: Zettlr is a desktop Markdown editor for writing notes and publications. It supports citations through integration with reference managers such as Zotero and JabRef, and offers LaTeX and Word template support. Exports are handled with Pandoc, LaTeX, and Textbundle. The app includes snippets for inserting boilerplate, custom CSS and theming with dark modes, code highlighting for many languages, and full-text search. It also supports Zettelkasten-style knowledge management with interlinking. The README also includes a developer guide covering the Electron/Vue/Node.js architecture, lint and test commands, packaging scripts, and build flags.
use_cases: Managing citations from a reference manager
Exporting drafts to Pandoc, LaTeX, or Word formats
Full-text searching across a notes folder
Contributing to an Electron desktop app
how_to_run: Download the latest release installer for macOS, Windows, or Linux from the project website or GitHub
notable: Citation integration with Zotero, JabRef, and other reference managers
Exports via Pandoc, LaTeX, and Textbundle
Build flags to disable update checks or skip bundling Pandoc for package-manager distribution
Community-supported, free and open source under GPL v3
caveats: Official builds cover macOS, Windows, and common Linux distributions; other Electron platforms require building from source
Building from source requires Node 22, Yarn, and native C++ toolchains
The project brand (name and icons) is excluded from the GPL license and all rights are reserved
